gameplan.summary: Gank with point-and-click ult lockdown and snowball carries. Transition into frontline bruiser.
gameplan.win_condition: Ult the enemy carry in every teamfight. Use W armor shred to enable your team.
gameplan.early_game: Q gap-close for early ganks level 3. E W passive gives strong dueling. Farm to 6 fast.
gameplan.positioning: Initiate with ult on carry. Peel with Q for your own carries after initial engage.

leesin.tips: He outduels you before level 6. Avoid early invade. After 6 your ult wins all duels.
leesin.power_shift: You win post-6 duels. He wins early jungle. Get ahead through ganking not dueling.

hecarim.tips: He outduels you and out-ganks you pre-6. Avoid early fights. Counter-gank his ganks.
hecarim.power_shift: He scales better. Win by targeting lanes he ignores and taking objectives.

warwick.tips: His ult suppresses you — don't duel near low-HP allies. Invade at level 2 before he heals up.
warwick.power_shift: Even. He sustains better; you engage better. Win through ganking over dueling.

diana.tips: She outduels you post-6 in extended fights. Gank faster and earlier before she stabilizes.
diana.power_shift: You win through pick potential on carries. She wins 1v1 sustained fights.

graves.tips: He wins all duels at all stages. Never fight him 1v1 in his jungle. Win through superior ganks.
graves.power_shift: He wins duels; you win teamfights. Avoid him and target laners.
